brandPoints.one: Describe your business in plain language.
brandPoints.two: Hear your agent answer before you pay anything.
brandPoints.three: Go live on a real phone number when you are ready.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to your workspace.
login.redirecting: Taking you to the sign-in page…
login.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Free to start — 20 trial credits, no card needed.
signup.terms: By continuing you agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.body: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it, then come back here.
verify.bodyNoEmail: We sent you a confirmation link. Open it, then come back here.
verify.stillUnverified: Your email is not confirmed yet. Give the link a moment, then try again.
verify.spam: Not in your inbox? Check the spam folder.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It expires in a few hours.
forgot.social: Signed up with Google? Use the Google button on the sign-in page instead.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.body: Password resets happen on our secure sign-in page. Open the link from your email to set a new password, then sign in below.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.body: Add a one-time code from an authenticator app to every sign-in.
mfa.verifying: You will be asked to sign in again and enrol an authenticator app.

select.title: Choose a workspace
select.subtitle: You belong to more than one. Pick where to work.
select.empty: You are not a member of any workspace yet.

setup.title: Set up your workspace
setup.subtitle: A workspace is your business on Oraly. You can invite your team later.
setup.name: Business name
setup.timezoneHint: Business hours and reports use this time zone.
setup.phoneHint: E.164 format, e.g. +14155550123. You can add this later.
setup.trialNote: You start with 20 free credits for browser test calls.

invite.title: Join workspace
invite.body: You have been invited to a workspace. Sign in with the email address the invitation was sent to, then accept below.
invite.missing: This invitation link is missing its token. Ask the person who invited you to send it again.
invite.invalid: This invitation is not valid or has expired. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
invite.alreadyMember: You are already a member of this workspace.
invite.wrongAccount: Signed in as {email}. If the invitation went to another address, sign out and sign in with that one.

errors.NETWORK: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.FORBIDDEN_ROLE: Your role in this workspace does not allow that.
errors.NOT_A_MEMBER: You are not a member of that workspace.
errors.OWNER_ONLY: Only the workspace owner can do that.
errors.WORKSPACE_PAUSED: This workspace is paused. Contact support to resume it.
errors.GENERATION_PAUSED: Agent generation is briefly paused for maintenance. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.PURCHASES_PAUSED: Purchases are briefly paused for maintenance.
errors.BRIEF_INCOMPLETE: Tell us a bit more about the business and what a good call achieves first.
errors.GENERATION_FAILED: We could not write the agent this time.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.TEST_RATE_LIMIT: Too many test calls. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.INVITE_INVALID: This invitation is not valid or has expired.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: You are already a member of this workspace.
errors.PLAN_LIMIT: Your plan does not include that.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
errors.UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: A service we depend on is unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.NOT_CONFIGURED: This feature is not ready yet. Our team has been notified.
errors.title: Something went wrong

validation.url: Enter a full address, starting with https://
validation.name: Between 2 and 80 characters
validation.transferNumber: A transfer rule needs a number to transfer to

w1.title: What should your agent do?
w1.subtitle: Pick the closest fit. You can change every detail on the next step.
w1.industryHint: Tailors the examples and placeholders you see next.
w1.empty: No templates are available right now.
w1.existing: You already started an agent from the {template} template. Continue with it, or pick another template to start over.
w1.premiumHint: Uses the Premium voice stack (1.5 credits per minute).

w2.title: Tell us about your business
w2.hint: Write like you would explain it to a new hire. Plain sentences work best — the agent turns them into a script.
w2.generateHint: Fill in the first two fields to generate.
w2.generatedBody: Version {version} was written from your brief. Review the summary, then choose a voice.
w2.failedTitle: We could not write the agent
w2.failedBody: Nothing was lost — your answers are saved. Try again in a moment.
w2.editAfter: Changed something? Regenerate to update the script.

card.empty: Fill in the brief and this summary writes itself.

about_business.label: About your business
about_business.hint: What you do, who you serve, where you are. 20–1,000 characters.
about_business.placeholder: We are a family dental practice in Toronto with three dentists. We see adults and children for check-ups, cleanings, fillings and emergencies.

goal.label: What a good call achieves
goal.hint: The one thing the agent should get done on most calls.
goal.placeholder: Book the caller into the next free slot, or take a message with their name and number if the request needs a person.

business_hours.label: Business hours
business_hours.hint: When a person is available. Outside these hours the agent takes messages.

address.label: Address
address.hint: What the agent says when someone asks where you are.

services.label: Services
services.hint: Press Enter after each one. Up to 30.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.hint: Only what the agent may quote. Leave blank and it will never give a price.
pricing.placeholder: Check-up and cleaning from $150. Emergency visit $95 plus treatment.

faqs.label: Frequently asked questions
faqs.hint: Questions callers ask, with the answer you want given.
faqs.question: Question
faqs.answerPlaceholder: Yes, but appointments are seen first.

never_do.label: Things the agent must never do
never_do.hint: Hard rules. These override everything else.
never_do.placeholder: Never give medical advice. Never confirm an appointment without a phone number.

handoff_rules.label: When to hand off to a person

actions.read_message: Read a message to the caller

personality.label: Personality
personality.hint: Nudge the tone; the script does the rest.

anything_else.label: Anything else
anything_else.hint: Parking, accessibility, languages spoken at the desk — anything a caller might ask.
anything_else.placeholder: Free parking behind the building. We speak French.

ai_disclosure.label: Telling callers it is an AI
ai_disclosure.hint: It will never claim to be human, whatever you choose.

always.title: Always say so
always.body: Opens every call with a short note that it is an AI assistant.

if_asked.title: Only if asked
if_asked.body: Answers honestly when a caller asks, otherwise gets on with the call.

never_volunteer.title: Never volunteer it
never_volunteer.body: Same as above, but never brings it up on its own.

w2.slow: This is taking longer than usual. Your answers are saved — leave this page open and it will finish on its own.

w3.title: Choose a voice and languages
w3.subtitle: Every voice can say your greeting. Premium voices sound more natural and cost 1.5 credits a minute.
w3.alsoSpeaksHint: Up to four more. The agent switches when a caller does.
w3.alsoSpeaksMax: You can add up to four extra languages.
w3.previewFailed: We could not play that voice right now.
w3.previewLimited: Too many previews. Give it a moment.
w3.emptyAll: The voice catalogue is being refreshed. Check back in a few minutes.
w3.stale: The voice list may be out of date. New voices appear after the next refresh.
w3.tierChange: This voice switches the agent to the {tier} tier.

groups.alsoSpeaks: Also speaks {language}, with its own accent

w3.sampleHint: Speed changes the clip too. Your agent says your own greeting on the test call.
w3.temperatureHint: Heard on calls, not in the clip.
